scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate colorblind-safe palette and compound swarm+boxplot show real design intent, but percentile labels visibly collide with the subtitle text and the top-earner callout for Sam Q. is clipped at the right edge — concrete layout bugs that cap the score.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Encoding is structurally honest — log scale appropriate for income, bee swarm avoids binning bias, box plot statistics are data-driven, no lie factor or dual-axis issues — but x-scale domain is hardcoded [14000,550000] rather than derived from data, and no key functions on .data(nodes) (acceptable here since the viz is static with no updates).
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static pre-computed swarm with no brush, zoom, or transitions; unified pointer-event tooltips eliminate all five failure modes.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single conceptual view with 4 well-separated colorblind-safe categories and a pre-computed (non-animating) swarm keeps cognitive load low; the 5 leader-line callouts in the upper-right are slightly crowded but don't impede reading the distribution.
